role: Full new-paper experiment protocol, fixed before added runs; builds on disclosed historical development and test exploration, not public preregistration
uniform_moment_control_note: This is the complete existing hybrid unary-plus-uniform-pair-moment encoder formerly studied as PairComp, not a newly published baseline. Keep the architecture and all results; change the display name to its role as a compositional mechanism control.
selection: Training and dev checkpoint selection as in saved suite. Core: five seeds; ancillary: three matched seeds. Fixed mixture settings unchanged. Dev-only LR search on the actual main split; selected Mean backbone is shared by Mean and PairProto.
main_result_policy: Report development-selected neural baselines and PairProto on the exactly same selected Mean backbone; retain fixed-configuration results separately. Replication carries main-development-selected hyperparameters without re-tuning on replication tests.
raw_score_selection: Dev-only mean MRR over the first three seeds, separately for raw herb and raw pair scores; save lock before tests. Includes unblended gamma=1 statistical baseline. No claim of fairness from a fixed raw mixture alone.
uncertainty: Five-thousand resamples by formula ID and by exact recipe group; MRR and Hits@1 differences conditional on matched seed-averaged predictions. Report seed SD and relation-macro MRR separately.
manuscript: Rewrite existing English main and separate Supplementary Materials.tex in place; preserve authors and funding, archive prior sources; provide Chinese companion. Use result-generated tables and claims; display pending status until the experiment matrix is complete.
safety_scope: Knowledge association retrieval only; no clinical efficacy, pharmacological synergy, graded clinical-evidence or zero-shot cross-graph transfer claims. Known herb entities and target relations are assumed.
retained_negative_evidence: Historical ID-holdout results and DragonTCM exploratory findings remain accessible; neither is deleted to favour the new method. Main recipe-disjoint choice is motivated by overlap audit, not test rank.
